title: Korean BBQ: Ordering with Friends
subtitle: Casual evening at a samgyeopsal restaurant in Korean

sentences.en: Welcome! How many people are there?
There are four of us. Is there a table available?
Please give us four servings of pork belly and one bowl of soybean stew.
sentences.target: 삼겹살 사 인분하고 된장찌개 하나 주세요.

sentences.en: Would you like soju or beer to drink?
We will have one bottle of soju and two bottles of beer.
sentences.target: 소주 한 병하고 맥주 두 병 주세요.

sentences.en: Excuse me, can we get more lettuce, please?
Sure, I will bring it right away.
After we eat, we would like to order one cold noodle dish at the end.
sentences.target: 다 먹고 나서 마지막에 냉면 하나 주문할게요.
